analysis: This PR is documentation-only: a new changelog fragment (changelog.d/app-attest-diagnostic-wording.md), docs/provider/attestation.md (lines 62 and 70) and docs/provider/troubleshooting.md (the App Attest and key-history doctor rows). No code, authorization, routing, revocation or serving-policy logic changes. The wording changes are: (1) the `darkbloom doctor` key-generation countdown is described as a provider-local safeguard, not an Apple deadline or the coordinator's retry time, and the coordinator may retry later under its enrollment backoff; (2) key history now reports generation-attempt totals and the last recorded native failure, and states that a generation count plus a recorded invalidKey does not establish per-key attestation outcomes. Both changes make the diagnostics more conservative and accurate, consistent with T-057 and T-058 (diagnostics are untrusted metadata, never authorization). The docs state the diagnostics are outside the signed transcript and never used for authorization. They add no new data exposure: the report still carries only closed patterns and numeric codes, is admin-run and is never sent automatically. No threat assumptions are invalidated. One item cannot be confirmed from the supplied sources: the new link `../reference/app-attest-shadow.md#invalid-key-enrollment-backoff` points to a file that is not in this diff, so the anchor's existence is unverified. That is a docs-link issue, not a security issue. The code files named in the docs (AppAttestDeepDiagnosis.swift keyHistory, AppAttestShadowClient.swift recordAppleFailure) were not in the diff, so the doc claims about the diagnostics code are unverified.
